description: This file defines wrapper functions and interfaces for nl80211 Wi-Fi management, including functions for sending management frames, setting station info, and retrieving interface and station information, specifically for use with T_EndPoint context.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame command over nl80211 with specified parameters.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Sets station information for the endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Configures the endpoint to use 4 Mac addresses if specified.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information, including MLD and MLO link info, for the endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a remote AP BSSID.
